Gideon, the corrected Vantorre Group seat count is 280. I replied in the thread in #strategic-pod.

You first posted 300 at 09:14 on 1 Jul. At 09:19 you corrected it to 280, because the 300 came from a staging tab that included sandbox logins from the May rollout. The 280 is the active production roster as of 1 Jul. I can't say whether the count has changed since then.
